description: Stormwater Acres by GI is a dataset listed in County of San Mateo open data portal (performance.smcgov.org), an open data portal (Socrata) of a region, state, county or agency, published or maintained by County of San Mateo. Coverage: San Mateo County, California. The portal files it under the category Environment. Its tags are stormwater, green infrastructure. The table has 3 columns. Attribution on the portal: County of San Mateo - Office of Sustainability. The portal shows 2023-02-16 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is public domain (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support urban drainage and flood-risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-performance-smcgov-org-portal.
